description: Defines the FilePath class, an abstraction for handling platform-specific file path operations, including path manipulation, component extraction, and normalization, with platform-specific considerations for Windows and POSIX systems.

classes.name: base::FilePath
classes.description: A platform-agnostic class for representing and manipulating filesystem paths, supporting operations like component extraction, extension handling, path normalization, and appending components, with platform-specific behaviors for Windows and POSIX.

methods.name: GetComponents
methods.description: Splits the path into its individual components, including root indicators.

methods.name: IsParent
methods.description: Checks if the current path is a strict parent of another path.

methods.name: AppendRelativePath
methods.description: Appends a relative path to the current path if it is a parent.

methods.name: DirName
methods.description: Returns the directory component of the path.

methods.name: BaseName
methods.description: Returns the last component of the path, typically a file or directory name.

methods.name: Extension
methods.description: Returns the file extension, including the dot.

methods.name: FinalExtension
methods.description: Returns the file extension without double extensions.

methods.name: RemoveExtension
methods.description: Removes the file extension from the path.

methods.name: ReplaceExtension
methods.description: Replaces the current file extension with a new one.

methods.name: InsertBeforeExtension
methods.description: Inserts a suffix before the file extension.

methods.name: AddExtension
methods.description: Adds a new extension to the filename.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends a component or path to the current path.

methods.name: IsAbsolute
methods.description: Checks if the path is absolute.

methods.name: EndsWithSeparator
methods.description: Checks if the path ends with a separator.

methods.name: AsEndingWithSeparator
methods.description: Returns a copy of the path ending with a separator.

methods.name: StripTrailingSeparators
methods.description: Removes trailing separators from the path.

methods.name: ReferencesParent
methods.description: Checks if the path references a parent directory ('..').

methods.name: LossyDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable Unicode string of the path.

methods.name: MaybeAsASCII
methods.description: Returns the path as ASCII if possible.

methods.name: As8Bit
methods.description: Returns the path as an 8-bit string.

methods.name: NormalizePathSeparators
methods.description: Normalizes path separators to platform-specific standards.

methods.name: NormalizePathSeparatorsTo
methods.description: Normalizes path separators to a specified character.
